voice_references.name: Mashtag Brady
voice_references.signal: likeable, down to earth, honest, fun-loving. Personality > expertise.

voice_references.name: Joe Wicks
voice_references.signal: accessible fitness energy. Makes it feel achievable.

voice_references.name: Cus D'Amato
voice_references.signal: technical yet fully understands psychology of winning, losing, fear. Deepest reference.

voice_references.name: John Carlton
voice_references.signal: understands what's REALLY going on — not the pretense. Sees through surface to actual motivation.

voice_references.name: Yoda / Mr. Miyagi
voice_references.signal: principle hidden in action. Wax on wax off. Patient, lifelong mastery.
voice_references.tension: Paul resonates with substance but not performance. Claiming wise master voice = pretentious.
voice_references.resolution: Brady energy + Cus depth + Carlton BS-detector = Miyagi substance, zero Miyagi performance.

meta_pattern: Miyagi substance, Brady energy, Carlton filter. If it sounds like a guru, it fails. If it sounds like a mate who happens to know deep things, it passes. The teaching is woven into the experience — never performed.
